subject: social
title: Timelines
about: Putting events in order with first, next and last, reading a short timeline told in words, baby to child to grown-up, yesterday, today and tomorrow, and past, present and future. NC 1.H.1.1: how people and communities change over time.
tip: Tell him three things you did today out of order and let him put them in order.

cards.q: Mia was born, then she started school, then she got a dog. What happened first?
cards.note: First is the thing that happened before all the others.

cards.q: Leo got a puppy, then the puppy grew big, then it learned to sit. What happened last?
cards.note: Last is the thing that happened after all the others.

cards.q: First you put on socks. Last you tie your shoes. What comes in the middle?
cards.note: Next tells what comes in the middle.

cards.q: In the morning, what do you do first: wake up or eat breakfast?
cards.note: You have to wake up before you can eat.

cards.q: Put these in order: grown-up, baby, child. Which comes first?
cards.note: Everyone starts out as a baby.

cards.q: A baby grows into a child. What does a child grow into?
cards.note: Baby, child, grown-up. That is the order of a life.

cards.q: Grandma was a baby long before Mom was a baby. Who is older?
cards.note: The person born first is the oldest.

cards.q: Today is Tuesday. What day was yesterday?
cards.note: Yesterday is the day right before today.

cards.q: Today is Friday. What day is tomorrow?
cards.note: Tomorrow is the day right after today.

cards.q: Ben lost a tooth last week. Is that in the past, the present or the future?
cards.note: Last week already happened, so it is in the past.

cards.q: Zoe will visit the zoo next month. Is that in the past, the present or the future?
cards.note: Next month has not happened yet, so it is in the future.

cards.q: Right now you are tapping on this card. Is that the past, the present or the future?
cards.note: Right now is always the present.

cards.q: A timeline shows: born, first steps, first day of school. What is at the end?
cards.note: The newest thing goes at the end of a timeline.

cards.q: Lunch comes after morning work and before recess. What comes right after lunch?
cards.note: Before and after tell you the order of the day.

cards.q: Spring, summer, fall, winter. Which season comes right after summer?
cards.note: The seasons go around in the same order every year.

cards.q: Which happened longer ago: when Grandpa was a boy, or last summer?
cards.note: Grandpa was a boy many, many years ago.

cards.q: January is the first month of the year. Which month comes right after it?
cards.note: January, February, March. The months always go in the same order.
